title: review: R11: orchestrator/speculation.py — selective speculative execution: strict eligibility, shadow estimator of economic benefit, deterministic single-result selection, mode off by default (AP P17)
spec:
Why: AP P17 / brief P13 ask for an experimental, OFF-by-default capability to run a rare critical-path task on two executors and keep exactly one result; before any dispatch path exists the architecture needs eligibility, a shadow estimator answering "would speculation have paid", deterministic result selection and telemetry. Dispatching the duplicate is NOT part of this task (a later daemon task, only if evidence supports it).
What: new pure module orchestrator/speculation.py.
- cfg [speculation]: mode off|shadow|active (default off), min_fix_round_p 0.5, min_samples 5, min_retry_cost_usd 1.0, security_paths from [review].security_paths.
- eligible(task, *, priority, ready_priorities, evidence, snapshot, budget_left_usd, cfg=None) -> {"eligible": bool, "reasons": [...], "executors": [a, b] or []}: requires all of: critical (priority critical_path_s == max over ready), fix_round_p >= min_fix_round_p with n >= min_samples for the baseline executor, expected retry cost (fix_round_cost_usd) >= min_retry_cost_usd, spare capacity (at least two distinct eligible executors with free > 0 in snapshot, brief: never speculate because capacity is idle alone), budget_left_usd >= 2 * cost_to_accepted_usd, safe to duplicate (task_class not security, no scope path matching security_paths or containing migration/config/pool.toml). Every failed condition appended to reasons; an ordinary task lists "not_critical".
- shadow_estimate(root=STATE, evidence=None) -> rows per merged lineage with fix rounds: {"task", "initial_usd", "fix_round_usd", "dup_cost_usd" (2 x initial), "expected_saved_usd" (fix_round_usd x p_other_first_pass - initial_usd), "latency_saved_s" (fix-round wall time), "would_have_paid": expected_saved_usd > 0} using scorecard.executor_economics and pipeline stamps; summary(rows) -> {"n", "paid_rate", "net_usd"}.
- select_result(candidates) -> {"selected", "discarded", "reason"} over [{executor, tests_green, gate_reds, usd, duration_s, sha}]: exactly one selected: green first, then fewest gate_reds, then lowest usd, then shortest duration, then executor id; no green -> selected None with reason no_green; never returns two.
- plan(task, **eligibility_kwargs) -> {"speculate": bool, "mode", "reason", "eligibility"}: off -> speculate False reason mode_off (eligibility still computed for the shadow estimator); shadow -> False with would_speculate; active -> eligibility["eligible"]. record(task_id, plan) -> decision_log.record(kind="speculation", ...). Selected results still go through the normal gate, review and serial merge (documented; nothing here merges).
acceptance: tests/test_speculation.py::test_default_mode_off_never_speculates — empty config: plan returns speculate False with reason mode_off even for a fully eligible task
tests/test_speculation.py::test_ordinary_task_is_ineligible_with_reasons — a non-critical task with low fix_round_p lists not_critical and low_fix_round_p

tests/test_speculation.py::test_critical_path_task_with_high_rework_and_capacity_is_eligible — active mode, critical task, fix_round_p 0.7 n 8, two free executors, budget ok: speculate True with two distinct executors
tests/test_speculation.py::test_insufficient_budget_or_no_spare_capacity_blocks — budget_left below 2x cost yields insufficient_budget; a single free executor yields no_spare_capacity

tests/test_speculation.py::test_select_result_picks_exactly_one_and_estimator_summary — two green candidates yield one selected by gate_reds then usd, the other discarded; shadow_estimate rows carry would_have_paid and summary paid_rate

result.summary: Diffstat matches the packet (354 insertions across orchestrator/speculation.py and tests/test_speculation.py). Ran the full test file with unittest: all 7 tests pass, including the 5 named acceptance tests. Verified eligible()'s field-name aliasing (fix_round_p/fix_round_probability, n/n_tasks, cost_to_accepted_usd/cost_to_accepted, first_pass_p/first_pass_green_rate) against the real return shape of scorecard.executor_economics — all correctly fall back to the real names. select_result's tie-break order (green, gate_reds, usd, duration_s, executor id) matches spec and the test. shadow_estimate's fix_round_usd/expected_saved_usd/would_have_paid arithmetic matches the test's expected values (2.1 and 0.68) exactly. decision_log.record is called with a valid kind ('speculation' is in KINDS) and matching keyword signature. _unsafe() correctly blocks security-classed tasks and migration/config/pool.toml/security_paths scope, satisfying the 'safe to duplicate' condition. No dispatch or merge logic is present — module only decides/measures, as required. Scope is limited to the two allowed files. No security-checklist concerns apply (no HTTP/CLI trust boundary, no secrets, no crypto, no migrations, no new dependencies).
